name_reason: Compliant fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: fd2_ game prefix, chapter_event_handler domain, descriptor ch9_reinforcement. The '1f' suffix is the per-event handler-table dispatch index 0x1F (table @ 0x51B91; verified 0x51B91 + 0x1F*4 = 0x51C0D, the sole xref to this fn), a meaningful domain ID that must be preserved -- NOT a Ghidra address residue. ch9 matches walkthrough (chapter_09.md: boss-death-triggered enemy reinforcement). No address residue anywhere in the name.
purpose: Chapter-9 reinforcement-spawner cinematic: loads the next reinforcement portrait batch and plays a 4-corner camera scan to reveal the spawn arrivals.
logic_summary: __CHK(0xC) stack-probe prologue (compiler-injected). Reads the batch counter byte [0x10] of the tile-event consumed-flags block, calls fd2_load_chapter_portraits_and_dump_tmp with it (load + dump that batch to FD2.TMP), then post-increments the counter so the next invocation loads the following batch. Then a fixed 4-corner camera scan: fd2_pan_cursor_and_window to (0,0),(0xC,0),(0xC,0xB),(0,0xB) (TL->TR->BR->BL) each followed by fd2_delay_ms(200). No branches, no RNG, no numeric computation, no CALL-return value consumed. The arg is never read. The final delay is reached via 'PUSH 0xC8; JMP 0x353D1' into a shared delay tail (code-folding artifact); emitted as an inline call for Layer-2 equivalence.
